name: reframe
description: Compute the rotation-aware reframe crop for placing a source video in a target aspect (the project canvas). Returns {sourceCrop, sourceWidth, sourceHeight} to write verbatim onto a project clip item — sourceCrop is null when the source's DISPLAY aspect already fits the target (vertical footage on a vertical canvas needs no crop). Gates and computes off display dimensions, never coded dimensions: a rotated iPhone clip codes 1920x1080 but displays 1080x1920, and cropping off the coded aspect squeezes already-vertical footage into a stretched sliver. No encode — geometry only.

input.description: Source video file (probed automatically; rotation metadata is honored)

output.description: {sourceCrop: {x,y,w,h}|null, sourceWidth, sourceHeight, source: {codedWidth, codedHeight, rotation, displayAspect, targetAspect, mode}}. The first three fields go verbatim onto the clip item; 'source' is diagnostics only.

params.name: target
params.description: Target aspect as W:H — the project canvas, e.g. 9:16 (vertical) or 16:9 (landscape). Default: 9:16.

params.name: mode
params.description: Framing mode. 'zoom' centers the crop horizontally — the only mode today; thirds/mix framing are future work.
